tests/interfaces/store/test_reducer_single_source.py:45 `rebar.link(tid, epic, "relates_to", repo_root=r)  # LINK (no promotion)` — the only link is OUTGOING from tid; tid has no inbound edge, so inbound_deps would be empty regardless of the fmt guard

ABSENCE: test_show_inbound_deps.py exercises only the default (JSON) CLI output via `_cli_show` (subprocess with no `--output llm`) and MCP; no case builds an inbound edge and then asserts `show --output llm` output lacks the `inbound_deps` / its llm short-key
advisory.finding: The `--output llm` inbound-free contract that this diff explicitly introduces (`include_inbound=fmt != "llm"` in reads_cli.py) is not regression-covered: no test asserts that `show --output llm` omits `inbound_deps` for a ticket that actually HAS an inbound edge. The cited test_llm_parity_show_vs_list runs against _rich_ticket, which has only an outgoing relates_to link and zero inbound edges, so its inbound_deps is empty whether or not the guard fires — inverting the guard so the llm arm leaks inbound_deps would not fail any test.
scenarios: A future change flips or drops the `fmt != "llm"` guard so the llm arm starts emitting inbound_deps, silently breaking show↔list llm parity — the suite stays green.
